title: Lionsgate Acquires Alma Har’el’s ‘Wet’ Starring Connor Storrie, Rebecca Ferguson, Odessa A’zion and More
content:
ByPayton Turkeltaub

Lionsgate has acquired the North America and UK distribution rights to “Wet,” director Alma Har’el’s latest film, from Fifth Season and 193, A Legendary Company.

“Wet” features an all-star cast, which includesConnor Storrie, Rebecca Ferguson, Odessa A’Zion,Javier Bardem, Rosalia and Lukas Haas. Production is set to begin in 2027, while further details surrounding the film’s plot are not yet available.

Har’el is the award-winning director behind films including “Honey Boy,” “LoveTrue,” “Shadow Kingdom” and “Bombay Beach.” She’s been nominated for two Film Independent Spirit Awards, one for best director for “Honey Boy” and one for “Bombay Beach.” With “Honey Boy,” Har’el became the first woman to win the DGA Award for first-time feature film.

Har’el created, executive produced and directed the Natalie Portman and Lupita Nyong’o-led limited series “Lady in the Lake” for Apple TV+ in 2024.

Christian Stangeby co-wrote the screenplay with the director. Previously, Stangeby edited and worked on a number of short films and TV series, including “Ex on the Beach Norge” and “Hotellet.”

“The script and package for ‘Wet’ are undeniable,” said Adam Fogelson, chair of Lionsgate Motion Picture Group. “With Alma at the helm, we cannot wait to get in the water with this unbelievably talented group of people, both in front of and behind the camera.”

“Lately, I’ve had to find humor in chaos and humanity in the most unpredictable situations,” said Har’el. “I’m grateful to Lionsgate for embracing a film that speaks to this wild moment in time. I’m incredibly excited to bring this remarkable group of actors together and make a film that refuses to behave.”

Fifth Season and 193 will produce, in addition to Har’el, Christopher Leggett and Riva Marker for Linden Entertainment. Fifth Season’s Christopher Slager and Graham Taylor will executive produce with Patrick Wachsberger and Ashley Stern for 193. Ferguson is repped by Anonymous and WME.

Scott O’Brien and MaryGrace Stephenson are overseeing the project for Lionsgate. Jordan Backhus will oversee creative for Fifth Season. Christopher Davis and Lauren Bixby negotiated the deal on behalf of the studio. WME Independent, 193 and BALA negotiated the deal on behalf of the filmmakers.
title_zh: 獅門影業(Lionsgate)收購了阿瑪·哈瑞爾(Alma Har’el)執導的電影《濕(Wet)》，該片主演包括康納·斯托里(Connor Storrie)、麗貝卡·弗格森(Rebecca Ferguson)、奧德莎·阿齊翁(Odessa A’zion)等人。
content_zh:
由佩頓·圖克爾塔布(Payton Turkeltaub)報導

萊昂斯蓋特(Lionsgate)已獲得《濕潤(Wet)》在北美和英國的發行權，該片是導演阿爾瑪·哈雷爾(Alma Har’el)的最新作品，由第五季(Fifth Season)和193公司聯合製作。

《濕潤(Wet)》擁有全明星陣容，包括康納·斯托里(Connor Storrie)、麗貝卡·弗格森(Rebecca Ferguson)、奧德莎·阿齊翁(Odessa A’Zion)、哈維爾·巴登(Javier Bardem)、羅莎莉亞(Rosalia)和盧卡斯·哈斯(Lukas Haas)。製作計劃於2027年開始，至於影片的劇情細節目前尚未公開。

哈雷爾是多部獲獎影片的導演，包括《蜜蜂男孩(Honey Boy)》、《真愛(LoveTrue)》、《陰影王國(Shadow Kingdom)》和《孟買海灘(Bombay Beach)》。她曾兩度獲得電影獨立精神獎提名，一次是因《蜜蜂男孩》獲最佳導演提名，另一次則是因《孟買海灘》。憑藉《蜜蜂男孩》，哈雷爾成為第一位獲得導演工會獎(DGA Award)最佳首次長片的女性。

哈雷爾於2024年為Apple TV+創作、執行製作並導演了由娜塔莉·波特曼(Natalie Portman)和露皮塔·尼永奧(Lupita Nyong’o)主演的限量系列《湖中的女士(Lady in the Lake)》。

克里斯蒂安·斯坦吉比(Christian Stangeby)與導演共同編寫了劇本。此前，斯坦吉比曾編輯並參與多部短片和電視系列的製作，包括《挪威海灘情人(Ex on the Beach Norge)》和《酒店(Hotellet)》。

萊昂斯蓋特電影集團主席亞當·福格爾森(Adam Fogelson)表示：“《濕潤(Wet)》的劇本和包裝無可否認。隨著阿爾瑪的掌舵，我們迫不及待想要與這群在鏡頭前後都極具才華的人一起潛入水中。”

哈雷爾表示：“最近，我不得不在混亂中尋找幽默，在最不可預測的情況下尋找人性。我感謝萊昂斯蓋特能夠支持一部反映這個瘋狂時代的電影。我非常興奮能夠將這些卓越的演員聚集在一起，製作一部拒絕乖乖聽話的電影。”

第五季(Fifth Season)和193公司將共同製作，哈雷爾、克里斯多福·萊吉特(Christopher Leggett)和瑞瓦·馬克(Riva Marker)將為林登娛樂(Linden Entertainment)製作。第五季的克里斯多福·斯雷格(Christopher Slager)和格雷厄姆·泰勒(Graham Taylor)將與派屈克·瓦赫斯伯格(Patrick Wachsberger)和阿什莉·斯特恩(Ashley Stern)共同擔任193公司的執行製作人。弗格森由匿名公司和WME代理。

斯科特·奧布萊恩(Scott O’Brien)和瑪麗·格雷斯·史蒂芬森(MaryGrace Stephenson)正在為萊昂斯蓋特監督該項目。喬丹·巴克赫斯(Jordan Backhus)將負責第五季的創意監督。克里斯多福·戴維斯(Christopher Davis)和勞倫·比克斯比(Lauren Bixby)代表該工作室談判了這筆交易。WME獨立公司、193和BALA則代表電影製作人進行了交易談判。
